label: FarmProduct
description: Something a farm sells direct — the item, its price, and the storefront it was found on (harvested from farm websites and commerce platforms by farm.rootz.global). Epistery-published vocabulary rather than schema.org/Product because the record's value is the link back to the farm that grows it; price is a live observation and the origin is always fresher than any index.

trust.note: Reserved — commerce proof points (storefront ownership bound to the farm record, price observation time) as the market defines them.
